title: Mikayla Nogueira’s Plan to Build a Beauty Brand for the Ages
summary: The creator-entrepreneur and her POV Beauty cofounder Ani Hadjinian took the stage at the Beauty Inc Catalysts conference to talk brand-building and the power of community.
